name: What types of insulation are available for homes?

mainEntity.name: What types of insulation are available for homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common types of home insulation include fiberglass, mineral wool, cellulose, and spray foam. Each type offers different R-values, installation methods, and cost considerations. Fiberglass is a popular, cost-effective option, while cellulose is often made from recycled materials. Spray foam provides an excellent air seal and high R-value, but typically has a higher upfront cost. The best choice depends on your home's structure, budget, and specific insulation needs.
